text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume claiming first place on the chrysanthemum stage is none other than
Biwa Hayahide!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haah, haha... heheh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I have finally "defeated" her.
Without question, this is my...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's a win!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Taishin. That was fun, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you kidding—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm gonna win next time!!
Woooaaahhhhh~~~~!! Let's do thiiis~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. What's with that guy?
Wandering off again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Still... I agree.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I have returned, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Aaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, was that loud voice Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taishin! Great work today!
Thank you for giving me such a good race!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "No way? Seriously, Hayahide? Is there a ticket inside or something?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's not in!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... yeah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ehhh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm, ahem... My apologies.
It seems I got carried away in the heat of the moment.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... it's fine,
I've already wiped it from my memory.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Hayahide.
Do you have a goal race in mind for your next one?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Next... huh. That's true.
We ran through the Classic Triple Crown route.
In that case, beyond this winter—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm. A prestigious spring race.
I certainly want to set our sights on that stage of the strong held in Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's a crucial race if you want to become the strongest of your generation, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. Got it.
I'll participate in that too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I just want to win. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...'Want to win', is it? You're right.
Perhaps I've finally managed to stand on equal footing with you all."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We're going for the win as well, though.
From here on out, we'll keep winning and stand at the top of our generation!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her smile was far brighter
and clearer than it had ever been before.
